title: 第147章 接下来生死与共第146章 局势不利
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
云洛的视线毫不掩饰，羽黛很快有所察觉。
她凌厉的凤眼朝这边看来，发现是云洛后，停留片刻，又毫无波澜挪开。
看起来，就像是毫无交集。
这个小小的插曲并没有引起太多人的注意。
云洛收回目光，和静笃退远了一些，暗中观察。
上神雷劫威力不容小觑，但时间上却要短上许多。
短短一个月后，灼尧便结束了雷劫。
法阵消散那刻，他顾不上跪在原地恭迎他回归的部下，硕大的身躯眨眼蹿到云洛和静笃跟前。
他憋屈了太久，所以此刻急需发泄自己的多年的压抑。
“静笃，云洛，这仙界终究还是属于我们仙族的。”
他巨大的金瞳俯视二人，明明是象征着光明的明亮色彩，此刻竟如深不见底的魔渊，阴冷诡谲。
云洛感觉到一股熟悉的力量朝她压来，是混沌之力。
在灼尧上神的威压下，如拔山之力想要将她撕裂成两半。
云洛双手结印抵挡，但护身灵罩刚聚起没多久便像脆弱的蛋壳破碎。
她喉咙间溢出一股血，静笃忙上前两步。
只是法术刚成形，巨大的龙尾轻轻一扫，像是一把利刃，硬生生将虚空斩成两半，中间出现一道引力巨大的深黑裂口。
静笃的攻击，便如石沉大海被那裂口吸收，没有留下半点涟漪。
金龙落地，灼尧化作魁梧的人形。
“半步上神？”
他嘴角轻蔑勾起，“可惜，终究还是下神。”

他目光从静笃身上收回，阴鸷转向云洛。
相较于静笃这个多年的老对手，云洛这个冉冉升起的后辈反而更让他忌惮。
他感觉到了她身上那股熟悉的气息，也深知，两人拿到的传承的主人也是死对头。
天注定，他们要站在对立面。
静笃发现他对云洛起了杀意，立刻唤出三头蟒，三颗硕大的蛇头几乎将嘴张开成一个平面，里面无数毒雾和毒虫朝灼尧扑去。
云洛聚气凝神，天河倾竖于身前，剑尖朝上，她划破指尖，天空立刻出现巨大的金色法阵。
她直接使出了天渊引。
一时，毒虫和剑阵齐齐朝灼尧面门而去。
灼尧只是冷冷勾唇，右臂化作龙爪，再空中轻轻一划。
有一条长长的黑色裂口出现，往日神仙也触之即死的毒虫在触碰到裂口边缘时便立刻化作黑雾。
而云洛的剑阵，明明可以轻松瞬杀那朵能碾压夜缙黎和沈栖尘的向日葵，此刻也竟被那裂口吞噬了大半的力量。
剩下的一半，也只是让灼尧向后躲避了几步。
content_en:
Yun Luo's gaze was undisguised, and Yu Dai quickly noticed.
Her sharp phoenix eyes looked this way, and when she discovered it was Yun Luo, she paused for a moment, then moved away without any trouble.
It seems like there is no intersection.
This little episode didn't attract much attention.
Yunluo withdrew his gaze, stepped back from Jingdu, and observed secretly.
The power of the Divine Thunder Tribulation cannot be underestimated, but the time is much shorter.
Just one month later, Zhuo Yao ended the thunder tribulation.
The moment the magic circle dissipated, he ignored his subordinates who were kneeling on the spot to greet his return, and his huge body jumped up to Yun Luo and Jing Du in the blink of an eye.
He had been feeling aggrieved for too long, so he urgently needed to vent his years of repression.
"Jingdu, Yunluo, this immortal world still belongs to our immortal clan after all."
His huge golden eyes looked down at the two of them. They were obviously bright colors symbolizing light, but at this moment they were like a bottomless abyss, cold and strange.
Yunluo felt a familiar force pressing towards her, it was the power of chaos.
Under the pressure of Lord Zhuoyao, the force of a mountain tried to tear her in half.
Yunluo formed seals with his hands to resist, but the protective spiritual shield shattered like a fragile eggshell not long after it was assembled.
A stream of blood overflowed from her throat, and Jingdu took two steps forward.
Just when the spell was formed, the huge dragon tail swiped lightly, like a sharp blade, cutting the void in half, and a deep black crack with huge gravity appeared in the middle.
Jingdu's attack was absorbed by the crack like a stone sinking into the ocean, leaving no ripples.
The golden dragon landed, and Zhuo Yao transformed into a burly human form.
"Half step to godhood?"
The corners of his mouth curled up contemptuously, "It's a pity that I still got distracted after all."
He withdrew his gaze from Jingdu and turned to Yunluo with a sinister look.
Compared to Jingdu, his old rival for many years, Yunluo, the rising junior, made him more afraid.
He felt the familiar aura on her body and knew that the owner of the inheritance they obtained was also a sworn enemy.
It was destined that they would stand on opposite sides.
Jingdu found out that he had murderous intentions towards Yunluo, and immediately summoned the three-headed python. The three huge snake heads almost opened their mouths into a flat surface, and countless poisonous mist and poisonous insects inside rushed towards Zhuoyao.
Yunluo concentrated her energy, Tianhe stood upright in front of her, the tip of the sword pointed upwards, she cut her fingertips, and a huge golden magic circle immediately appeared in the sky.
She directly used Tianyuan Yin.
At that moment, the poisonous insects and the sword formation all headed towards Zhuoyao's front door.
Zhuo Yao just curled his lips coldly, turned his right arm into a dragon claw, and made a slight stroke in the air.
A long black crack appeared, and poisonous insects that in the past would kill even gods would immediately turn into black mist when they touched the edge of the crack.
Yun Luo's sword array could easily and instantly kill the sunflower that could crush Ye Jinli and Shen Qichen, but at this moment, most of its power was swallowed up by the gap.
The remaining half only caused Zhuo Yao to dodge back a few steps.
